title: Planning in 8 Tokens: A Compact Discrete Tokenizer for Latent World Model
abstract: arXiv:2603.05438v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: World models provide a powerful framework for simulating environment dynamics conditioned on actions or instructions, enabling downstream tasks such as action planning or policy learning. Recent approaches leverage world models as learned simulators, but its application to decision-time planning remains computationally prohibitive for real-time control. A key bottleneck lies in latent representations: conventional tokenizers encode each observation into hundreds of tokens, making planning both slow and resource-intensive. To address this, we propose CompACT, a discrete tokenizer that compresses each observation into as few as 8 tokens, drastically reducing computational cost while preserving essential information for planning. An action-conditioned world model that occupies CompACT tokenizer achieves competitive planning performance with orders-of-magnitude faster planning, offering a practical step toward real-world deployment

translated_title: 8个Token内的规划：一种面向潜在世界模型的紧凑离散分词器
translated_abstract: 世界模型提供了一个强大的框架，可以在动作或指令条件下模拟环境动态，从而支持动作规划或策略学习等下游任务。近期的方法将世界模型作为学习得到的模拟器来使用，但其应用于决策时规划时计算成本过高，难以实现实时控制。一个关键瓶颈在于潜在表征：传统分词器将每个观测编码为数百个token，使得规划既缓慢又消耗大量资源。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CompACT，一种离散分词器，它将每个观测压缩到仅8个token，在保留规划所需关键信息的同时大幅降低了计算成本。采用CompACT分词器的动作条件世界模型在实现数量级更快规划速度的同时，达到了具有竞争力的规划性能，为迈向真实世界的实际部署迈出了务实的一步。
tldr: CompACT是一种将每个观测压缩至仅8个token的离散分词器，使潜在世界模型在保持规划性能的同时实现数量级的规划加速，为实时控制和实际部署提供了可行方案。
en_tdlr: CompACT is a discrete tokenizer that compresses each observation into as few as 8 tokens, enabling latent world models to achieve competitive planning performance with orders-of-magnitude faster planning for real-world deployment.
